purpose: Local-only safety contract for automated read-only reconciliation. This contract does not authorize an apply.

targetMigrationBaseline.reason: 0028_migration_ledger.sql is intentionally local and unapplied during Phase 1C.5. Reconciliation may only use an export at the known 0001–0027 staging baseline.

rules: Existing D1 records are never updated by default.
Target-protected R2, Dropbox, provider, audit, approval, and operational metadata is target-authoritative.
Timestamps are comparison evidence only and never independently authorize an overwrite.
A source-only record is only a proposed INSERT; it requires a reviewed approved manifest and a future enabled apply command.
No credential, session, token, secret, R2 binary, or provider connection value is a migration payload.
Every future write must be creator-scoped, manifest-scoped, ledgered, and verified before the next record is attempted.
Automated resolution must never downgrade target-authoritative data, create a future canonical creator, or auto-apply an AUTO_ELIGIBLE finding.
futureApplyRequirements: fresh read-only target export and exact baseline verification
explicit approved manifest checksum and approval reference
single approved creator and domain scope
record-level before/after evidence and append-only D1 ledger
post-write foreign-key, creator-isolation, duplicate, and application-read verification
